headline: Locus-resolved tools scale variant interaction, colocalisation and SV detection
label: Locus Level Variant Analysis Tools
summary: Million-scale colocalisation and genome-wide interaction screens are becoming tractable through GPU/FPGA acceleration and standardized variant benchmarking.
synthesis: Most items here are computational tools, and the common thread is locus-resolved analysis of genomic variation. GWAIS-Web performs genome-wide SNP-SNP interaction screening in case-control GWAS with GPU/FPGA acceleration, and gpu-coloc reports a roughly 1000-fold speedup for genetic colocalisation across millions of association signals. GrassSV combines depth-of-coverage and contig-based recognition to detect major structural variant classes from high-throughput DNA-seq data. Aardvark adds a basepair score for haplotype comparison, reducing representation bias for small variants. ReSeT selects reference genomes using a facility-location objective with an inter-taxon discrimination term and an ambiguity index, benchmarked on viral datasets. What is new is the extension of locus-resolved analysis to pairwise interaction and colocalisation at million-scale, alongside benchmarking of variant representation.
